title.en: The Crown Is Not the Prize

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: And this year’s crown goes to William Hayes!

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: Keep it. I already found something I want more.

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Someone, you mean?

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: Someone who gets to decide whether I’m worth their time.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: That is a very expensive speech for someone who forgot to ask their name.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: I know their name. I wanted them to hear it from me.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: Then say it.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: Welcome to Northbridge, Hayden. This night belongs to you, not the crowd.

scenes.staging: 舞会直播结束，William走下台，群演形成可见通道。 进入此场景准确切换到 `BG01`；台词逐条出现，手机消息仅作为可编辑UI浮层。

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: He’s giving you a crown. I can offer an exit that isn’t surrounded by cameras.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: Or you can stay. Nobody gets to make this decision for you.

lines.speaker: NICOLE
lines.text: Tell me you’re seeing this. The whole school is screaming. Are you okay?

scenes.staging: 两人站在同一露台，William递王冠，Alex伸手但不触碰玩家。 进入此场景准确切换到 `BG02`；台词逐条出现，手机消息仅作为可编辑UI浮层。

lines.speaker: SCREEN
lines.text: ONE OF THEM HAS BEEN LYING TO YOU.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: That isn’t part of the show.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: Who gave them access to the display?

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: Look at me. Whatever this is, you don’t owe anyone a scene.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: I memorized your name before I knew whether you’d ever say mine.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: If the spotlight makes you uncomfortable, say the word. I’ll get you out.

scenes.staging: 舞会屏幕故障，警告浮层后期叠加，切回二人惊讶表情。 进入此场景准确切换到 `BG01`；台词逐条出现，手机消息仅作为可编辑UI浮层。

label.en: I’ll take it. Now tell me why you chose me.

choices.said: I’ll take it. Now tell me why you chose me.

responses.speaker: WILLIAM
responses.text: Because you looked past the stage. Because you weren’t impressed when everyone else was.

choices.bridge: William slips the crown into your hands, then moves aside so the cameras cannot trap you.

label.en: Show me that exit.

choices.said: Show me that exit.

responses.speaker: ALEX
responses.text: Gladly. But first, I want you to know I noticed you long before tonight.

choices.bridge: Alex opens the terrace door and waits outside rather than taking your hand.

label.en: No more performances. Who knows me here?

choices.said: No more performances. Who knows me here?

responses.speaker: WILLIAM
responses.text: I know your name. I don’t know who put that message on the screen.

responses.speaker: ALEX
responses.text: And I won’t pretend otherwise.

choices.bridge: Both men tell the host to stop filming; Nicole takes you to a quiet hallway.

chapters.gameNote: 王冠触摸；当 William 第一次看向玩家时，切近景，不要延迟出现眼神回应。 可跳过，结果只影响线索、角色独特记忆，不剥夺主线。

lines.speaker: NICOLE
lines.text: If you need me, I’m one building away. And yes, that was the weirdest welcome party I’ve ever seen.

lines.speaker: PLAYER (NARRATION)
lines.text: My phone lights up before I can answer. Two new messages.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: You looked overwhelmed. I owe you a real introduction. Tomorrow, eight. Public park.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: He’s not the only one who wants to see you. Same time, different bench.

lines.speaker: NICOLE
lines.text: Two invitations in thirty seconds? You really are trouble.

scenes.staging: Nicole视频通话，玩家整理搬家纸箱。 进入此场景准确切换到 `BG03`；台词逐条出现，手机消息仅作为可编辑UI浮层。

lines.text: I’ll be wearing the silver chain from my picture. You can leave whenever you want.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: Silver ring. Awful habit of telling the truth at the worst possible moment.

lines.speaker: PLAYER (NARRATION)
lines.text: The chain catches the light. So does the ring. No faces.

lines.speaker: NICOLE
lines.text: Meet in public, send me your location, and don’t let them turn a date into a dare.

lines.text: I don’t mind waiting. I mind being an afterthought.

lines.text: For the first time tonight, I get to decide what happens next.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: I’m trying very hard not to double-text. How am I doing?

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: I saved you the seat by the window. You can say no. I’ll still save it for tomorrow.

choices.said: I’d rather hear your real voice first. Meet me at the café?

choices.said: Not at the same time. You each get your own conversation.

responses.speaker: WILLIAM
responses.text: Fair.

responses.speaker: ALEX
responses.text: Fairer than pretending I’m the only one.

lines.text: Across the path, someone stands by the empty bench. I see only the edge of a silver chain.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: I was there. When you left, I thought I’d missed my chance.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: I didn’t show up because you asked to meet someone else first. That mattered.

choices.said: Something’s wrong. I’m leaving. We can try another day.

responses.text: Good call. Text me when you’re safe.

choices.bridge: William sees your departure message and waits until he knows you are safe.

choices.said: Nicole’s coming. I’m not staying here alone.

choices.said: Tomorrow. Daylight. Coffee. No surprises.

responses.text: I’ll bring the coffee. You bring the questions.

choices.bridge: The park meeting is cancelled and William meets you by daylight, not secretly.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: I’m W. I should have said that without making you guess.

lines.text: And since secrets are apparently going out of style...

lines.text: He sets down coffee. A silver ring circles his index finger.

lines.text: A. That’s me. Disappointed?

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: Alex, that’s not how an apology works.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: Good. I wasn’t apologizing for liking them.

lines.text: The pictures were meant to keep things simple. Then you walked into the ballroom.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: Simple is overrated. Honest is harder.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: No more anonymous games. I promise.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: I can promise to tell you when I’m scared to answer. That’s more real.

lines.text: Come to rehearsal one night. No crowd, no crown.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: Or come listen to a song I’m not ready to release.

lines.speaker: PLAYER (NARRATION)
lines.text: Two invitations. This time, I know whose faces are behind them.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: You weren’t meant to meet a picture of me. You were meant to meet me.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: I like that you looked me in the eye before you checked the ring.

choices.said: Why hide behind a letter when everyone knows your face?

responses.speaker: WILLIAM

choices.bridge: William shows the chain and says: “I wanted you to recognize me, not owe me anything.”

label.en: Were you afraid I wouldn’t choose you if I knew?

choices.said: Were you afraid I wouldn’t choose you if I knew?

responses.speaker: ALEX
responses.text: I was afraid you’d only see what people say about me.

choices.bridge: Alex rolls the ring across his knuckles. “I was going to tell you. I should have sooner.”

label.en: No more testing me. Either you show up as yourselves, or don’t show up.

choices.said: No more testing me. Either you show up as yourselves, or don’t show up.

responses.speaker: WILLIAM
responses.text: Understood.

responses.speaker: ALEX
responses.text: I can do that.

choices.bridge: Both admit the anonymous game went too far and agree to stop testing you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER (NARRATION)

lines.speaker: NICOLE
lines.text: Both of you. Give them space.

W.title: William·公开偏爱之后，是每天的选择

lines.speaker: HAYDEN
lines.text: I don't want the crown. I want the person who stayed when the cameras went away.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: Good. The crown was heavy anyway.

lines.speaker: HAYDEN
lines.text: And when I'm not easy to love?

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: Then we'll have a hard day. I'll make coffee. You'll tell me what I got wrong. We'll do the work.

lines.speaker: HAYDEN
lines.text: That sounds less dramatic than the dance.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: It's the part I wanted most.

A.title: Alex·没写完的副歌终于有了明天

lines.speaker: HAYDEN
lines.text: I'm not choosing the easy story. I'm choosing the one you tell me honestly.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: Then here's the truth. The train leaves at seven on Monday. I hate how much I'm going to miss you.

lines.speaker: HAYDEN
lines.text: Then call me when it gets quiet.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: I will. Not to check where you are. Just to hear about your day.

lines.speaker: HAYDEN
lines.text: And the song?

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: It still has a space in it. We can decide together what goes there.

SELF.title: Hayden·没人能替我给自己命名

lines.speaker: HAYDEN
lines.text: I like both of you. But I need a life that doesn't begin with someone asking me to choose.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: Then have that life. I hope I get to hear about it.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: And if you want the studio key for your own music, ask. No strings.

lines.speaker: NICOLE
lines.text: I booked us breakfast. Not a date. Just a very serious appointment with pancakes.

lines.speaker: HAYDEN
lines.text: That's exactly what I want.

OPEN.title: 协商开放·所有人都先说出自己的意愿

lines.speaker: HAYDEN
lines.text: I don't want either of you to agree because you're afraid I'll leave.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: Then I need to be honest. I want to try, slowly, with actual conversations.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: I can try talking about it. I won't promise I'm never going to feel jealous.

lines.speaker: HAYDEN
lines.text: We can stop if it stops feeling right. I want everyone to have a choice.

lines.speaker: WILLIAM
lines.text: Then start with breakfast. Three people. No audience.

lines.speaker: ALEX
lines.text: And no scoreboard.

zh.And this year’s crown goes to William Ha: 今年的冠军是威廉·海斯！

zh.I know their name. I wanted them to hear: 我知道他们的名字。我想让他们从我这里听到。
zh.He’s giving you a crown. I can offer an: 他在给你加冕。而我能给你一条没有镜头包围的退路。

zh.Gladly. But first, I want you to know I: 乐意之至。但首先，我想让你知道，早在今晚之前我就注意到你了。
zh.Alex opens the terrace door and waits ou: 亚历克斯打开露台的门，在外面等着，而不是牵起你的手。
zh.No more performances. Who knows me here?: 别再演了。这里谁认识我？

zh.He’s not the only one who wants to see y: 不是只有他想见你。同一时间，不同的长椅。

我快到了。待在灯光下别动。

zh.A security whistle cuts through the tree: 一声安保哨声划破树林。
zh.Hey, eyes on me. We are not investigatin: 嘿，看着我。我们第一次约会可不调查神秘声响。
zh.I’m here if you need me. You don’t need: 需要的话我就在。你不需要证明什么。

zh.Across the path, someone stands by the e: 小路对面，有人站在空长椅旁。我只看到一条银链的边缘。
zh.I was there. When you left, I thought I’: 我当时在场。你离开时，我以为我错过了机会。
zh.I didn’t show up because you asked to me: 我没出现，是因为你让我先见别人。那很重要。
zh.Something’s wrong. I’m leaving. We can t: 不对劲。我要走了。我们改天再试。
明智的选择。安全了给我发消息。
zh.William sees your departure message and: 威廉看到你的离开消息，一直等到确认你安全。
zh.I’ll be wearing the silver chain from my: 我会戴着照片里那条银链。你想走随时都可以走。

如果明天感觉不对，说一声就行。

我正拼命忍住不连发消息。我表现得怎么样？
zh.I saved you the seat by the window. You: 我给你留了靠窗的座位。你可以拒绝。明天我还会给你留着。
zh.Eight works. The well-lit side of the pa: 八点可以。公园光线好的那一侧。

比假装我是唯一一个要公平得多。

zh.If the answer is me, I’d rather hear it: 如果答案是我，我更想悄悄听你说。
zh.And if it isn’t? I’ll survive. Dramatica: 如果不是呢？我也能接受。虽然会很戏剧化，但我能接受。

zh.For a second, the party seems to happen: 有那么一瞬间，派对仿佛重新上演了一遍，这次是通过别人的镜头。

zh.William, can we have one quiet minute?: 威廉，我们能单独待一分钟吗？
zh.NEW TRANSFER, TWO HEARTTHROBS, ONE SECRE: 新转学生，两个万人迷，一个秘密？

这本来就不该被发出来。
zh.William steps away from the crowd before: 威廉从人群中走开，然后问你是否还想要那个吻。
zh.Look at me. We can deal with the interne: 看着我。网络的事我们可以之后再处理。你现在需要什么？

zh.I don’t make private decisions for a roo: 我不会为一屋子陌生人做私人决定。

zh.Nicole arrives and witnesses the retreat: 妮可到了，目睹了撤退；那台不明相机仍是线索。
zh.Tomorrow. Daylight. Coffee. No surprises: 明天。白天。咖啡。别搞惊喜。
zh.I’ll bring the coffee. You bring the que: 咖啡我来带。问题你来提。
zh.The park meeting is cancelled and Willia: 公园的见面取消了，威廉在白天见你，不再偷偷摸摸。
zh.Before you say it: yes, I was the guy by: 你先别说：没错，长椅边那个人就是我。
zh.The silver chain glints as he leans forw: 他俯身向前时，银链闪了一下。
zh.I’m W. I should have said that without m: 我是W。我本该直接说，而不是让你猜。
zh.And since secrets are apparently going o: 既然秘密显然已经不流行了……
zh.He sets down coffee. A silver ring circl: 他放下咖啡。一枚银戒圈在他的食指上。
亚历克斯，道歉可不是这么道的。
zh.Good. I wasn’t apologizing for liking th: 很好。我可不是在为喜欢它们道歉。

简单被高估了。坦诚更难。
不再玩匿名游戏了。我保证。
zh.I can promise to tell you when I’m scare: 我可以答应你，当我害怕回答的时候会告诉你。那样更真实。

zh.Or come listen to a song I’m not ready t: 或者来听一首我还没准备好发布的歌。
zh.Two invitations. This time, I know whose: 两个邀请。这一次，我知道背后是谁的脸。
zh.You weren’t meant to meet a picture of m: 你本该遇见的不是我的照片。你本该遇见的是我。
zh.I like that you looked me in the eye bef: 我喜欢你在看戒指之前先看着我的眼睛。
zh.Why hide behind a letter when everyone k: 既然所有人都认识你的脸，为什么还要躲在信后面？
zh.Because nobody ever asks who I am after: 因为认出我之后，从来没有人问过我是谁。你问了。
zh.William shows the chain and says: “I wan: 威廉展示着链子说：“我想让你认出我，而不是觉得欠我什么。”
zh.Were you afraid I wouldn’t choose you if: 你是怕我知道真相后就不会选你了吗？
zh.I was afraid you’d only see what people: 我是怕你只看到别人对我的评价。
亚历克斯把戒指在指节间滚动。“我本来打算告诉你的。我应该更早说。”
zh.No more testing me. Either you show up a: 别再试探我了。要么你们以真实的样子出现，要么就别出现。
zh.Both admit the anonymous game went too f: 两人都承认匿名游戏太过分了，并同意不再试探你。
zh.New rule. Nobody kisses anybody they don: 新规则。不许亲任何你并非真心想亲的人。
zh.I want this documented. No one gets to u: 我要把这件事记录下来。没人能把我的生活当成素材。
zh.I’m with you. I’ll send the screenshots: 我站你这边。我会把截图发给学工处。
zh.Nicole helps you export the threatening: 妮可帮你把那条威胁信息连时间戳一起导出了。

zh.Your public statement asks for privacy;: 你的公开声明请求隐私；论坛的反扑又成了新的压力。
zh.Phones away. I need people, not another: 手机都收起来。我需要的是人，不是又一份声明。
那我们就坐这儿。你想坐多久都行。
zh.William offers tea; Alex waits without d: 威廉递上茶；亚历克斯等着，不追问缘由。
zh.That badge. I know the logo. Campus Medi: 那个徽章。我认得这个标志。校园媒体。
埃里克在他们那儿管照片台。我认识他。

亚历克斯，我要听你的版本。不是他的。

去年秋天，埃里克和我有过一段短暂的关系。结束了。我跟他说我不想再有更多。
我会带着事件编号到场。
zh.Nicole helps preserve the evidence chain: 妮可帮助保全证据链，并确认了投诉编号。

zh.You invited a person who’s being harasse: 你把一个正在被骚扰的人约到一间偏僻的办公室。我们带了证人来。
zh.I was in the park with someone I was see: 我当时在公园和一个正在交往的人在一起。成年人。双方自愿。你需要知道的就这些。

校园可以决定谁配得上谁。

从控制台旁边退开。立刻。

我真希望自己能早点到。我现在在这里了。
zh.Nicole, send everything to the superviso: 妮可，把所有东西都发给主管。现在。

我的手机震动了。又是埃里克。
zh.Want the truth about that night? Archive: 想知道那晚的真相？档案室。九点。一个人来。
zh.If you go, I’ll come. If you don’t, I’ll: 如果你去，我就来。如果你不去，我还是会帮你举报。
zh.I wrote this when I still thought leavin: 我写这个的时候，还以为先离开就不会受伤。

zh.I’m not judging your past. I need to tru: 我不是在评判你的过去。我需要信任你的现在。
那我就用接下来的行动来赢得这份信任。

zh.Let’s verify Eric’s claims with a witnes: 我们在有证人在场的情况下核实埃里克的说法。

premise.zh:
你20岁，刚来到北桥大学。妮可是住在附近的朋友，也是你在新校园里可以求助的人。
迎新舞会上，21岁的剧团演员威廉·海斯走下舞台，把王冠递向你；20岁的音乐人亚历克斯则为你指出一条远离镜头的出口。他们都想认识你，但是否接受邀请、与谁靠近，由你决定。
一条突然出现在舞会屏幕上的匿名信息打破了热闹。你还不知道谁在背后操纵，也不必在今夜给爱情一个答案。接下来的校园生活里，你可以了解他们、守住隐私，也可以选择友情和自己的未来。
premise.en:
You are twenty and new to Northbridge University. Your friend Nicole lives nearby and offers practical support as you settle in.
At the welcome dance, William Hayes, a twenty-one-year-old theater student, steps off the stage and offers you his crown. Alex, a twenty-year-old musician, points out an exit away from the cameras. Both want to know you; accepting an invitation or growing closer remains your choice.
Then an anonymous message interrupts the ballroom screen. You do not yet know who is behind it, and you owe nobody a romantic answer tonight. Across campus life, you can get to know them, protect your privacy, choose friendship, or make room for your own future.

you.zh: 你扮演20岁的大学新生海登，可以保留自己的显示名，自行决定感受、关系和边界。
you.en: You play Hayden, a twenty-year-old university newcomer. Keep your own display name and choose your feelings, relationships, and boundaries.

chapters: 迎新舞会当晚
The welcome-dance evening
舞台上的颁冠环节刚结束，威廉走向你。亚历克斯也在场；镜头和人群正关注着这次初见。
The crowning ceremony is ending. William steps toward you, Alex is nearby, and cameras and onlookers follow this first meeting.
舞会后的宿舍时光
Back at the dorm after the dance
搬家的纸箱还没收拾完，妮可打来视频电话。手机上又亮起两条新消息。
Moving boxes are still unpacked when Nicole calls. Two new messages light up your phone.
长椅约定的碰面时段
The arranged meeting by the bench
公园比舞厅安静。你来到约定的长椅附近，手机消息提醒你留在有灯光的地方。
The park is quieter than the ballroom. Near the meeting bench, a message asks you to stay where there is light.
公园碰面之后
After the park encounter
校园咖啡馆里，威廉坐到你对面，亚历克斯端着咖啡走近。银链与银戒让那晚的细节有了线索。
At the campus café, William sits opposite you and Alex approaches with coffee. A chain and a ring bring details of that night into focus.
朋友聚会时
During a gathering of friends
妮可主持的小聚会开始了游戏。起哄归起哄，谁也不必接受不想要的亲密接触。
Nicole hosts a small party game. Teasing does not oblige anyone to accept unwanted intimacy.
午夜期限之前
Before the midnight deadline
匿名威胁出现在手机上，对方试图逼你在午夜前作出选择。妮可正在视频通话中陪你整理情况。
An anonymous threat demands a choice before midnight. Nicole stays on the video call while you work out what has happened.
追查匿名消息时
While tracing the anonymous messages
校媒走廊里，一张媒体证引起妮可的注意。关于消息来源，你们仍需要可以核实的证据。
A media badge catches Nicole's attention in the campus-media hallway. The source of the messages still needs verifiable evidence.
离开校媒区域后
After leaving the media area
亚历克斯带你来到练琴房。他准备谈起一段已经结束的往事，也谈自己希望保留的边界。
Alex brings you to a practice room. He is ready to discuss a relationship that ended and the boundaries he wants respected.
约定核查资料时
At the arranged records review
校媒办公室里，埃里克等在电脑前。妮可和其他同伴一起到场，你不需要独自应对这次会面。
Eric waits at a computer in the campus-media office. Nicole and others accompany you; this meeting does not have to happen alone.
直播刚开始时
As the live broadcast begins
控制台旁还有校媒负责人，直播却突然放出一条脱离语境的私人消息。眼下需要先保护隐私。
A media supervisor is by the console when the broadcast displays a private message without its context. Protecting privacy comes first.
核对原始材料时
During the review of original material
负责人展示未经剪裁的原片与时间码。你们可以对照材料核查经过，而不是依赖传言。
A supervisor shows an uncropped original and its timestamp. You can examine records rather than rely on rumors.
学生事务处会面之后
After the student-affairs meeting
妮可陪你走出学生事务处。威廉带来热咖啡，亚历克斯拿着水；新的安排要先听你的意见。
Nicole walks out of student affairs with you. William brings coffee and Alex brings water; any new plans begin with your wishes.
剧场演出结束后
After the theater performance
剧场的灯光正在收拢。威廉准备分享舞台之外的自己；你此前是否赴约，会影响这次谈话的开头。
The theater lights are dimming. William is ready to share something beyond his stage persona; your earlier invitation choice shapes the conversation.
夜宵时分
Over a late-night meal
亚历克斯带你来到餐车旁。一顿简单的夜宵，让话题有机会从眼前的麻烦转向他的音乐。
Alex meets you by a food truck. A simple late meal leaves room to talk about his music beyond the recent trouble.
校园舞会当晚
The campus-dance evening
舞池里有人向你发出邀请。威廉和亚历克斯都在附近，第一支舞以及是否跳舞，仍由你决定。
Someone invites you onto the dance floor. William and Alex are nearby; whether to dance, and with whom, remains yours to choose.
舞会结束后的雨夜
The rainy night after the dance
威廉送你到宿舍门廊，雨水打湿了他的肩膀。他停在原处，没有替你决定下一步距离。
William accompanies you to the dorm porch, rain on his shoulders. He pauses without deciding how close you should be.
雨夜的楼梯口
At the steps on the rainy night
亚历克斯停在楼梯拐角，准备说清自己的期待。威廉没有跟过来，这是一段各自表达边界的谈话。
Alex stops at the turn of the steps to explain his expectations. William has not followed; this conversation leaves room for individual boundaries.
之后的一次校园散步
On a later campus walk
威廉和你沿校园步道散步。他想确认之前的相处是否让你舒服，公开靠近也需要先得到你的允许。
William walks with you across campus. He wants to know whether earlier moments felt comfortable; public closeness also needs your agreement.
练习室里的谈话时段
During a conversation in the practice room
亚历克斯在音乐与关系之间说出自己的担心。你可以回应，也可以把相处明确为友情。
In the music room, Alex talks about music and his worries about relationships. You can respond or make friendship explicit.
音乐教室里的会面
The meeting in the music classroom
音乐教室里，合起的琴盖隔在你们之间。接下来如何相处，需要每个人清楚表达自己的意愿。
In the music classroom, the piano lid is closed. What comes next requires each person to express what they want.
商量接下来日程时
While planning the coming days
日程表摊在桌上。这里只安排已经同意的相处方式，也要给课程、朋友和你自己的时间留位置。
A calendar lies open on the table. Plans must reflect existing agreements and leave room for classes, friends, and time of your own.
参观试镜后台时
During a visit behind the audition stage
威廉带你来到试镜后台，镜前贴满便签。他准备谈奖学金、校园形象工作和自己承受的压力。
William brings you behind the audition stage, where notes cover the mirror. He wants to discuss a scholarship, ambassador work, and the pressure he feels.
唱片店里的私人谈话
A private conversation in the record shop
亚历克斯带来两张原创封面草图。远离网络的喧闹，这里可以听他谈尚未完成的音乐。
Alex brings two original cover sketches. Away from online noise, there is space to hear about his unfinished music.
再次见面确认近况时
At a later check-in
你们再次讨论相处中的隐私与边界。此前作出的友情、暂停或约会选择，仍然有效。
You check in about privacy and boundaries. Earlier choices about friendship, pausing, or dating remain valid.
一起准备早餐时
While preparing breakfast
学生厨房里，威廉正为早餐忙碌。生活中的笨拙比舞台更近，也给你们留出了慢慢说话的空间。
William is making breakfast in the student kitchen. Ordinary mistakes leave more room for an unhurried conversation than a stage does.
驻地结果公布后
After the residency decision
唱片店里，亚历克斯带来驻地项目的结果。期末之后的行程，需要在保留彼此前途的前提下商量。
At the record shop, Alex shares the residency decision. Plans after finals need to leave room for each person's future.
看到校园投票时
When a campus poll appears
后台出现一场关于你们关系的舆论投票。是否回应、如何保护隐私，不该由围观者决定。
Backstage, a public poll turns your relationships into a contest. Onlookers do not decide whether you respond or how you protect privacy.
露天电影之夜
The outdoor-movie evening
妮可带来爆米花，威廉和亚历克斯也在场。没有必须表态的镜头，今晚可以只是一场朋友间的电影。
Nicole brings popcorn, and William and Alex are there too. With no camera demanding an answer, tonight can simply be a movie among friends.
作出最终选择之前
Before the final choice
威廉与亚历克斯分别谈起对未来的想法。听见他们的期待，不等于你必须答应；你自己的生活同样完整。
William and Alex speak separately about their hopes. Listening is not a promise, and your own life remains a complete future.
重返公园长椅时
On returning to the park bench
你们回到最初约定的长椅。威廉先到，亚历克斯随后；这一次，你可以按自己的意愿给出答案。
You return to the original meeting bench. William arrives first, Alex follows, and this time the answer is yours to give.
